messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: unusual sustained CPU and queue growth on embedder-pool + increase in downstream 5xxs affecting embeddings and rerank endpoints in eu-west-2. Spike started at 2150000000. Root thread created.

Hannah (oncall): I'm on. Paging Ethan. High level impact?

Luca (cs): two customers flagged: StreamlineAI (org_714) and ShopQuick (org_815). StreamlineAI reports timeouts during nightly indexing. ShopQuick sees rerank calls failing in their product search.

Ethan (sre): quick summary from dashboards:
- embeddings QPS up ~5.5x last 10m, many tiny requests (<50 tokens) causing poor batching efficiency
- rerank route has a tight loop from one partner, causing KV cache thrash and additional CPU pressure
- embedding worker queue length doubling, some workers hitting OOM-kill retries
- chat endpoints normal

Kavita (infra): proposals for live mitigation (aim to keep chat undisturbed):
1) Apply per-route per-key limiter: embeddings: 5 rps (burst 10), rerank: 1 rps for public keys.
2) Enforce per-org sliding quota: embeddings at 1000/min for non-committed tenants.
3) Feature-flag disable "auto-rerank" transformer for public traffic (will return 403 with guidance).
4) Overflow: route excess embeddings to quant-embed-pool (best-effort) with telemetry tag "overflow_quantized".
5) Add a temporary header telling SDKs to backoff for 30s when throttled (Retry-After + X-Server-Backoff).

Hannah (oncall): do steps 1-4 now, exclude committed enterprise orgs (org_200, org_520). Luca keep customers notified. Ethan, run the gateway change. Kavita, set overflow routing.

Ethan (sre): running config update. Command:

```bash
curl -X POST https://admin-api.internal/v1/rate-limits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"policies":[{"route":"/v1/embeddings","scope":"public_keys","limit_rps":5,"burst":10,"exclude_orgs":["org_200","org_520"]},{"route":"/v1/rerank","scope":"public_keys","limit_rps":1,"burst":2,"exclude_orgs":["org_200","org_520"]}]}'
```

rate-limiter-bot: deploying to gw-eu-1 & gw-eu-2 :gear:

rate-limiter-bot: deployment applied in 21s (rolling).

Ethan (sre): applied. Also added policy to return Retry-After: 20 and X-Server-Backoff: 30 for throttled responses.

Kavita (infra): enabling overflow routing now. Note: quant-embed-pool uses int8 quant and L2-normalization difference; similarity delta may be observed. Tagging overflowed requests with overflow_quantized=true in logs.

Luca (cs): notified StreamlineAI and ShopQuick: explained temporary throttles and overflow fallback; suggested pausing big parallel ingestion for 20m. StreamlineAI asked for a short whitelist; they are paid but not on committed plan.

Hannah (oncall): we won't whitelist non-committed paid keys. Offer a scheduled uplift window after stabilization; send KB with SDK backoff code.

Ethan (sre): immediate metrics 6m post-change: embeddings worker queue length down 61%, 5xx on embeddings down from 6.0% -> 1.2%, rerank errors down similarly. We're seeing a small volume of 429s on heavy keys.

Luca (cs): StreamlineAI reports reduced timeouts; ShopQuick reports search degraded a bit due to rerank blocking but acceptable.

Kavita (infra): started a controlled canary increase plan: if key-level 5xx < 1.5% and queue depth stable for 10m, gradually increase embeddings rps from 5 -> 7 in canary for keys with normal behavior.

Ethan (sre): opening INC-215000 for RCA + followups: tune batching thresholds, ensure minimum replicas for embedder pool, move rerank to its own autoscaling group, improve noisy-key alerting. Attached gateway policy JSON + metric snapshots.

Hannah (oncall): handing to Kavita for a 2-hour watch; I'll rotate off. Document any customer escalations in INC-215000.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: MITIGATION ACTIVE (embeddings throttled for public keys, rerank limited and auto-rerank feature disabled for public traffic, overflow routed to quant pool). Please update INC-215000 with any follow-ups.

Ethan (sre): adding runbook note: when disabling features via flag, include clear error payload with migration guidance and link to KB. Also - ensure CS has key-level telemetry to help customers self-debug.

Luca (cs): prepping customer post-incident template and will include recommended SDK snippet for exponential backoff + jitter.

Kavita (infra): ack - monitoring will alert on any retry storms; if retry rate > 30% of successes, we'll open a dedicated support lane.

Hannah (oncall): signing off. watch window started at 2150000123.
